title: Lighthouse Snow Globe
description: A glowing snow globe sits on a wooden surface against a dark background. Inside the transparent sphere, a black lighthouse stands on turbulent blue waves beside a small boat, while vibrant, swirling ribbons of yellow, green, pink, purple, and white light emanate from the illuminated lantern room.
prompt: A highly detailed surreal snow globe resting on a wooden table in a dark room. Inside the glowing sphere is a black lighthouse with its light on, a small boat on stormy blue waves, and dramatic swirling ribbons of colorful light in yellow, green, pink, purple and white exploding outward from the lantern. Dark moody background with luminous ethereal atmosphere, cinematic lighting, fantasy art style.
